Name: Ebu's Linus Portraits (Seasonal)
Author: ebuaskew
Description:
Making Linus's portrait has always been at the top of my list! I've tried on and off for a couple years, but his design was so complex, it was a bit overwhelming. Now that I'm starting to get the hang of pixeling, I thought I'd give him another shot.... and I'm happy to say he turned out exactly as I'd always wanted him to be! :') 

To celebrate, I took it a step further and made all of his seasonal outfits and a few alt portraits! I designed them to be compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Poltergeister's Seasonal Outfits mod[/url], but I'll be including a separate download for the 1.6 Vanilla version. 

[size=4]For Seasonal Outfits:[/size]
1. Unzip the files
2. Open your Seasonal Mods Folder > assets > Portraits > Linus 
3. Drag the images from Ebu's Portraits into the folder to replace
4. Repeat the process for sprites by dragging the files into your Seasonal Mods > assets > Characters > Linus

[size=4]For 1.6 Vanilla
[/size]1. Unzip
2. Drag the folder into your Mods folder
3. Open README for instructions on how toggle on/off beard accessories!

Downloads.Description: For use in the Seasonal Outfits mod
Download if you're playing without Seasonal Outfits (still includes winter outfits)
